title: The Dance of Spring
overview: Ten years ago, the balance of the seasons was broken. Now two girls set out to return spring to a frozen land.

title: Lingering Snow
overview: The return of spring arouses painful memories and conflicting feelings in the Agent of Winter.

title: A Glimpse
overview: Hinagiku and Sakura go to stay with the Agent of Summer and stumble into a sisterly feud.

title: Morning Calm
overview: Insurgents attack the Agent of Summer's home. The two Guards fight back.

title: Alone Together
overview: Hinagiku and Sakura approach the Village of Spring, recalling painful memories.

title: A Place to Call Home
overview: Sakura reflects on her reunion with Hinagiku and the challenges they overcame to begin their journey.

title: Dusk
overview: The young Agent of Autumn and her Guard go about their lives in a high-tech fortress.

title: Spring Rain
overview: In the aftermath of the latest attack, Rosei relives his past with Hinagiku and their violent separation.

title: United Front
overview: Rosei resolves to take action and contacts Sakura, only to get the last response he expected.

title: Afterimage
overview: Hinagiku recognizes Nadeshiko's kidnapper, and the newly united Agents finally identify their enemy.

title: Impatience
overview: Hinagiku and Sakura are waiting to meet the Winter duo at the Agency when the building comes under attack.

title: Assault
overview: Ishihara holds Rosei and Itecho at gunpoint, revealing her own past and the full scope of Kasai's attack.

title: Recapture
overview: Ruri, Ayame, and Rindo face Kasai in a battle to get Nadeshiko back.

title: Spring Flowers Bloom in Winter
overview: Hinagiku and Sakura confront Misuzu, and their pasts, head-on.
